query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'Products Details'[Products Category],
    TREATAS ( { 2020 }, 'Calender'[Year] ),
    "Sales", [Total Sales],
    "Cost", [Total Cost],
    "Profit", [Total Profit],
    "Qty", SUM ( 'Sales Data'[Quantity] ),
    "GrossSales", SUM ( 'Sales Data'[Sales Price WO Disc] ),
    "DiscountAmt", SUM ( 'Sales Data'[Discount] )
)
ORDER BY 'Products Details'[Products Category]
